item.title: A minimal ssg after 10 months' crawling
item.description: Ten months, ten modules, ~650 lines. A static site generator where the source file is the document: comments become prose, code becomes a highlighted block, and the boundary between them is the only format the machine needs to understand.

item.title: Effect is Kleisli, Etymologically
item.description: It's pretty intriguing that the Effect type in this blog is exactly the traditional Kleisli type in haskell. We'll further show that Monad is the constraint we need to form the valid Effect category. If you are wondering about the meaning of effects in the haskell world, I believe this blog will help gain some understanding.
